replies.if_they_say: How much do you charge for a website?
replies.reply: Hi! Packages range from INR 1,499 for a basic mobile page up to INR 3,599 for a multi-section setup, with domain setup at INR 800. You also pay only after you approve the work. What kind of business do you run, and what do you want visitors to do first (call, message on WhatsApp, or see a rate list)?

replies.if_they_say: Do you make websites for my type of business?
replies.reply: Yes, I build clean, fast pages for small businesses across India like clinics, salons, coaching centres, and local shops. The focus is always making your services, pricing, and contact button instantly clear on mobile. DM me what your customers ask you most often on chat, and I'll tell you how I'd lay it out.

replies.if_they_say: I already have an Instagram page, why do I need a website?
replies.reply: Instagram is great for discovery, but customers still have to message you to ask basic things like your address, services, and pricing. A simple one-page site gives them those answers in five seconds so you spend less time typing out the same replies. If you already have a link in bio or site, send it over and I will share three practical things to improve on it.
